## Context
We should probably have some way to check the version of the running thing.

## Recommended approach
Just add an endpoint somewhere that returns the version. There's probably an existing pattern for this kind of thing we can copy.

## Implementation steps
1. Add the endpoint.
2. Wire it up.
3. Make sure it returns something reasonable.

## Risks and mitigations
There could be some risks with this change but nothing major comes to mind.

## Test plan
Write some tests to make sure it works.

## Open questions
Not sure, will figure it out as we go.
